unbound_sources.accepted_join_request: Current network request owner only exposes this as its own requests table, not a records-backed kind. No second request kind is declared. Existing admitted_by_invitation member evidence remains usable; paths needing the unavailable request proof return 503.
unbound_sources.own_member_type_collection_fence: No native atomic collection witness is bound to this adapter. Per-row CAS guards do not cover an inserted row after the auth snapshot. A dependent mutation refuses before writes with community_collection_snapshot_unavailable; read-only queries and point-read membership paths remain available. The native source/transaction owner must bind the complete collection, installed model and routed resource set through domain commit.

write_contract.event_revision: Each RSVP changes the event membership revision in the same compare-and-swap batch as its member row.
write_contract.event_removal: All event and RSVP deletions are one batch; removal refuses before writes when the batch exceeds the door limit.
write_contract.default_rules: Only confirmed absence permits an insert; a CAS race rereads and returns the stored winner without replacing it.
